notion.description: Your Notion pages and databases: the ones connected to the Shipify integrations

needs: Two Notion integrations (notion.so/profile/integrations → New integration): one that can only read content, and one that can read, update and insert. Then share the pages Shipify may use with both (… → Connections).

telegram.description: Telegram: ask, remember, approve a list with a tap and get your links from your phone, through the edge (ADR 0031, ADR 0049)

needs: The edge's door App, set up (pnpm ship door setup --yes), and Cloudflare's deploy token in your credentials file
A Telegram bot: in Telegram, open @BotFather, send /newbot, choose a name, and copy the token it gives you

steps.say: Point the bot at the edge, one update at a time: messages and taps
Set the bot's menu of four, its description and its photo
Link you: open the link it shows, press Start, paste the id the bot sends
Send a test message to your phone

webchat.description: The web chat at shipify.<domain>/admin/chat: every task, threads, files, repeats, the notebook and the setup, from your phone or PC, through the door, with notifications when a reply comes (ADR 0036, ADR 0050)

needs: The status page, set up first (pnpm ship door page --yes), and Cloudflare's deploy token in your credentials file

steps.say: Check the status page is set up
Check the sign-in covers the chat (Access path admin/*)
Let your words in from the chat
